onboarding.text: Hey... Word is that when it comes to this kind of digging, nobody's better than you. / I need help, and I need it now.
onboarding.label: Reed

onboarding.text:
Sloane and I have been together for two years. I had never felt that way until we met at a pub.
This summer, we intended to relocate to Barcelona together. We have already purchased our tickets.
onboarding.label: Reed & Sloane

onboarding.text:
Then, a week ago, Logan — I share a flat with him — said he was fairly sure he'd seen her on a dating app. 
I brushed it off. Told him to stop messing about. 
And I've thought about nothing else since. 
What if he saw exactly what he thinks he saw?
onboarding.label: Reed

onboarding.text:
Last night she left her phone on the table and got in the shower. I copied everything before I could stop myself.
Tell me I'm wrong. I want to be wrong.
onboarding.label: Reed
